claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Palmitoylethanolamide is expected to be largely inactive at 2.5 uM; its known activities (PPAR-alpha activation, CB2 modulation) are cytostatic/anti-inflammatory rather than cytotoxic, and related endocannabinoids do not induce cell death at this concentration.
